name: memory-base
description: Memory Base for Claude Code: the owner's profile and handoffs at session start, relevant notes on every prompt, and the verbatim turn record kept beside them.

url.title: REST URL
url.description: Base URL of the memory-base REST API that the hooks call.

mcp_url.title: MCP URL
mcp_url.description: URL of the memory-base MCP server (streamable HTTP) that provides the memory tools.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The memory-base API key for this agent, sent as X-API-Key; held in the secure store.

author.title: Author
author.description: The profile owner and note author this agent saves as; it must be in the key's author list.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Where this agent's turns land; empty means the key's home namespace.
